facts.business: Northern Arc Capital Limited is a diversified, technology-led financial services platform that powers India's credit ecosystem by connecting borrowers, originator partners, lenders, and investors through an integrated platform, operating as an NBFC focused on underserved households and businesses.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Going forward, the Company intends to strengthen its fee-based businesses, primarily Placements and Credit Funds, to address the evolving funding requirements of its Originator Partners. At the same time, balance sheet lending will be deployed selectively to cultivate new partner relationships, demonstrate underwriting capabilities and support the development of scalable, long-term lending partnerships.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on inclusion of Default Loss Guarantee credit in calculation of Expected Credit Loss (Note 83(A))

key_risks: Significant management judgements and assumptions in measuring Expected Credit Losses (ECL)
Determining criteria for significant increase in credit risk and default risk
Credit risk in lending to underserved segments
